arStrings.szText: While at least {c_number}4{/c} {c_important}Wisdom{/c} Charms equipped, you gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} of your maximum Primary Resource per second. You lose all Primary Resource when it reaches full but gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
